title.en: Three games, one desktop, your PC stays yours
title.zh-CN: 三个游戏，一张桌面，电脑照样归你用

caption.en: A test script drives three Minecraft instances at once while the terminal in front keeps the focus. Recorded from the real screen.
caption.zh-CN: 测试脚本同时驱动三个 Minecraft 实例，前面的终端始终保持焦点。录的是真实屏幕。

title.en: Every line, live in the game
title.zh-CN: 脚本每一行，游戏里立刻生效

caption.en: Send-HeadlessKey E opens the inventory, Send-HeadlessMouse hovers and moves the sword, ESC closes it, in a window you never clicked.
caption.zh-CN: Send-HeadlessKey E 打开背包，Send-HeadlessMouse 悬停、挪动钻石剑，ESC 关闭，全程不用点那个窗口。

caption.en: Your mouse and keyboard go to your apps; the script reaches each game over its own pipe and gets an answer once the game has handled the input.
caption.zh-CN: 鼠标键盘只给你自己的应用；脚本通过各自的管道发给每个游戏，游戏处理完才返回。

caption.en: Send-HeadlessText types '/summon sheep' and '/summon cow' into chat; the game runs them like a player typed them.
caption.zh-CN: Send-HeadlessText 在聊天栏里输入 /summon sheep 和 /summon cow，游戏就像玩家亲手输入一样执行。

title.en: Hover and click where you aim

caption.en: A virtual cursor brings up tooltips and clicks slots; this picture is Save-HeadlessScreenshot of a window that was off the screen.
caption.zh-CN: 虚拟光标能触发物品提示、点击格子；这张图就是 Save-HeadlessScreenshot 对一个移出屏幕的窗口截的。

title.en: The games never take the focus

caption.en: Look at the title bars: only the terminal is active. Each game runs from its own cheap clone of the instance.
caption.zh-CN: 看标题栏：只有终端是激活的。每个游戏都跑在自己的实例克隆里，克隆又快又省空间。
